instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. In a sunny park with green trees, four children stand side-by-side in a friendly huddle. On the far left, the boy with glasses in a yellow t-shirt (R1) stands facing forward with a neutral expression. Next to him, the girl with curly hair in a brown dress and white cardigan (R3) looks forward. Beside her, the boy in a blue denim shirt (R5) smiles warmly. On the far right, the girl with dark hair and bangs in a striped dress and dark cardigan (R4) smiles broadly. They have their arms wrapped around each other's shoulders. Warm, bright sunlight filters through the trees from behind, creating a soft backlighting effect.
elements: R3 is the shoulder-huddle connector directly between R1 and R5, rather than R1 being between R3 and R5.
R5 is the shoulder-huddle connector directly between R3 and R4, rather than R4 being between R3 and R5.
R1 is an outside member of the shoulder huddle whose contact is with R3, rather than R3 being the outside member contacting only R1.
R1, R3, R5, and R4 stand side-by-side with arms wrapped around neighboring shoulders.
The group is in a sunny park with green trees.
